root_cause.text: In `airoha_qdma_init_rx_queue()`, `q->ndesc` was initialized before all resources (entry, desc, page_pool) were allocated and before `netif_napi_add()` was called, causing `airoha_qdma_cleanup()` to dereference a NULL NAPI pointer when a later allocation failed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `q->ndesc = ndesc;` to after successful descriptor and page_pool allocation and after `netif_napi_add()`, and also reorders page_pool creation after desc allocation to prevent memory leaks. The CVE description explicitly states that early ndesc initialization leads to a NULL pointer dereference in `airoha_qdma_cleanup()` because `netif_napi_add()` was never called for that queue.
